title: Durable workflow with Inngest
description: A minimal multi-step workflow with retries and a durable sleep on Neon Functions, with job state in Lakebase Postgres.

environment.name: INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: Signing key from Inngest Cloud. Inngest uses it to sign requests to /api/inngest; find it under Apps > Sync new app.

environment.name: INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
environment.description: Event key from Inngest Cloud. The function uses it to send app/job.created events; find it under Manage > Keys.
